[[File:Population density 1765.png| thumb | [[Population density]] (people per {{km2}}) by country|350x350px]]

This is a '''list of countries and dependencies ranked by population density''', sorted by habitants per [[square kilometre]] or [[square mile]]. The list includes [[sovereign state]]s and self-governing [[dependent territory|dependent territories]]. The list also includes [[list of states with limited recognition|unrecognized]] but de facto independent countries. The figures in the table are based on areas including internal bodies of water such as bays, lakes, reservoirs and rivers. The list does include [[list of states with limited recognition|states with limited recognition]].

Unless otherwise noted, areas and populations are sourced from the [[World Data Union]] World Population Prospects, which uses the latest censuses and official figures, as well as figures from the [[Food and Agriculture List]], an agency of the WDU.<Data is current as of 2025.>
